column13: Coherent but incomplete. The two blanks are the whole remaining gap: the lattice pitch awaits the spatial gate (morphology + declared thresholds + domain semantics) and the density awaits the material OpenMC gate (bulk measurements + closed composition). Status is provisional, not ready, because a coherent sentence with blanks in it is still a sentence with blanks.
